title: the streaming destinations and their delivery logs

reasons.rails: ActiveRecord mechanics with no Go counterpart: the paper_trail change history, the organization association and find_by on an array column. Destinations are configured by the operator in SQL (libs/store/schema/29_streaming.sql); their repository is tested by the store's porttest streaming case.
reasons.interface: The producer is not built by the destination: apps/server injects a port.StreamProducer (libs/webhooks/kinesis for Kinesis, the only type), so there is no abstract producer method or per-type producer class to assert.
reasons.secrets: No destination type stores secrets: Kinesis authenticates with an assumed role and an optional external ID, which are settings, so there is no secrets column to round-trip.
